Rashi on Eruvin 42a:10:1.hebrew: שמא ימשך אחר חפצו - חוץ לאלפים. הלכך, גזרינן טלטול בזריקה אטו הילוך:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:10:1.english: Lest he be drawn after his object - Beyond the two thousand [cubits]. Therefore, we decree [prohibiting] carrying by means of throwing on account of walking [beyond the boundary]:

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:11:1.hebrew: באלפים מיהת - שהוא מותר להלך בהן, וליכא למיגזר בהו משום שמא ימשך אחר חפצו, ניטלטל כי אורחיה, טלטול גמור, וכל שכן זריקה, דהא מחיצות מעלייתא נינהו? ומשני: כיון דחוץ לאלפים אסור לטלטל אפילו בזריקה משום שמא ימשך אחר חפצו, וכל שכן כי אורחיה דהא אין יכול להלך שם ולטלטל — מיתסר נמי באלפים, משום דהוי אלפים דיליה נפרצין לחוץ לאלפים דאסירי ליה משום גזירה שמא ימשך, דהא אין הפסק ביניהן, והויא מחיצה הנפרצת במלואה למקום האסור לה:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:11:1.english: Within two thousand, at any rate - Since he is permitted to walk within them, and there is no [reason] to decree regarding them lest he be drawn after his object, let him carry in his usual manner, [with] full carrying, and all the more so [by] throwing, for these are proper partitions? And [the Gemara] answers: Since outside the two thousand [cubits] it is forbidden to carry even by throwing, lest he be drawn after his object — and all the more so in his usual manner, for he cannot walk there and carry — it is forbidden within the two thousand as well, because his two thousand [cubits] are open to outside the two thousand [cubits], which are forbidden to him due to the decree lest he be drawn [after his object], for there is no barrier between them, and it is [considered] a partition that is breached in its entirety to a place that is forbidden to it.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:13:1.hebrew: ומטלטל באלפים - אפילו כי אורחיה, וחוץ לאלפים לא — אפילו בזריקה:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:13:1.english: And he may carry within two thousand [cubits] - Even in his usual manner; and outside the two thousand [cubits] [he may] not, even by throwing.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:13:2.hebrew: לא כרב נחמן ולא כרב הונא - ומה נפשך: אי גזר שמא ימשך — אפילו אלפים ניתסרו, משום מחיצה הנפרצת למקום האסור לה; ואי לא גזר שמא ימשך — לטלטל חוץ לאלפים בזריקה:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:13:2.english: Neither in accordance with Rav Naḥman nor in accordance with Rav Huna - Whichever way you look at it: If he decrees [prohibiting throwing beyond two thousand cubits] lest he be drawn [after his object], even [carrying within] the two thousand [cubits] should be forbidden, because of [the rule of] a partition that is breached into a place that is forbidden to it; and if he does not decree lest he be drawn [after his object], let him carry outside the two thousand [cubits] by throwing.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:15:1.english: Against Shmuel - For Rav Naḥman stated it in the name of Shmuel.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:15:2.english: As it was taught in accordance with his [opinion] - That we do not decree lest he be drawn [after his object].

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:1:1.hebrew: רבי נחמיה אומר במקומן - אם חזרו למקומן, יאכלו; אבל שלא במקומן — כל זמן שהן חוץ לתחום — לא יאכלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:1:1.english: Rabbi Neḥemya says: In their place - If they were returned to their place, they may be eaten; but [when] not in their place — as long as they are outside the [Shabbat] limit — they may not be eaten.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:1.hebrew: מאי במקומן - דשרי רבי נחמיה, היכי חזרו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:1.english: What is [meant by] “in their place” - that Rabbi Neḥemya permits: How did they return?

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:2.hebrew: אי נימא - אפילו במזיד, דחשיב להו אנוסין, והוי כהוציאוהו נכרים והחזירוהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:2.english: If we say - [That it is permitted] even intentionally, for he considers them [to have been under] duress, and it is like [the case where] gentiles took it out and returned it.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:3.hebrew: והתניא - אחריתי בהדיא: רבי אליעזר ורבי נחמיה אמרי, לעולם אסורין כו':
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:2:3.english: And is it not taught - [This is] another [baraita that teaches] explicitly: "Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Neḥemya say: They are forever prohibited, etc."

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:3:1.hebrew: אלא לאו - על כרחך האי במקומן בשוגג קאמר, מכלל דת"ק אף במזיד שרי היכא דחזרו, ותרתי קולא אית ליה:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:3:1.english: Rather, is it not - Perforce, this [phrase], “in their place,” means unwittingly, from which it follows that the First Tanna permits [them] even intentionally where they were returned, and he maintains two leniencies.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:3:2.hebrew: וחסורי מחסרא כו' שלא במקומן - שלא חזרו הוא דבמזיד לא יאכלו אם יצאו במזיד, אבל חזרו במקומן — (וזהו) במזיד נמי יאכלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:3:2.english: And it is incomplete, etc., [when] not in their place - It is [only when] they did not return that they may not be eaten if they went out intentionally; but [if] they returned to their place — (and this is:) [even] intentionally they may also be eaten.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:4:1.hebrew: ואתא רבי נחמיה למימר - האי "בשוגג יאכלו, במזיד לא יאכלו" דקאמר אשלא במקומן — אינו כן, אלא אמקומן איתמר: דאם חזרו למקומן, בשוגג יאכלו, אם במזיד לא יאכלו. ות"ק אית ליה דרב פפא:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:4:1.english: And Rabbi Neḥemya came to say - This [ruling], "if unwittingly they may be eaten, [and] if intentionally they may not be eaten," which [the first tanna] stated regarding [produce that is] not in its place — it is not so; rather, it was stated regarding [produce in] its place: that if they returned to their place, [if] unwittingly they may be eaten, [and] if intentionally they may not be eaten. And the first tanna holds in accordance with [the view of] Rav Pappa.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:5:1.hebrew: לא במזיד - אפי' במקומן, לת"ק אסור. ומתני' לא תחסר', אלא כדקתני — דלא איירי תנא קמא בחזרה כלל, ורבי נחמיה אשלא במקומן אתי לאפלוגי. דקאמר תנא קמא: שוגג יאכלו, ואתא רבי נחמיה למימר: האי חילוק דיהבת בין שוגג למזיד לאו אשלא במקומן איתמר, אלא במקומן. והכי קאמר ר' נחמיה: חזרו במקומן יאכלו, בהאי שוגג דקאמרת, אבל שלא במקומן — אפילו בשוגג לא יאכלו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:5:1.english: No; [if returned] intentionally - Even in their place, it is forbidden according to the First Tanna; and you do not need to emend the Mishnah [baraita as deficient], but rather [understand it] as it teaches — for the First Tanna does not deal with return at all, and Rabbi Nechemya comes to disagree regarding [produce that is] not in its place. For the First Tanna says: [If taken out] unwittingly, they may be eaten; and Rabbi Nechemya comes to say: This distinction that you made between unwitting and intentional was not stated regarding [when it is] not in its place, but rather in its place. And this is what Rabbi Nechemya is saying: [Only if] they were returned to their place may they be eaten, under this [circumstance of] unwitting [taking out] that you stated; but [while] not in their place, even unwittingly they may not be eaten.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:6:1.hebrew: והא מדתני - בהך אחריתי: "לעולם אסורין" כו', מכלל דבתרתי פליגי, ותנא קמא במזיד במקומן נמי שרי. דאי חדא קולא הוא דמיקל, ור' נחמיה בההוא הוא דפליג — הכי איבעי ליה למיתני, כדתנ' בקמייתא: "במקומן יאכלו, שלא במקומן לא יאכלו", ואנא ידענא דאשוגג דשרי תנא קמא שלא במקומן, קאתא רבי נחמיה למימר: הא דשוגג דשרי — במקומן הוא דשרי, שלא במקומן לא. ומדתנן: "לעולם אסורין עד שיחזרו שוגגין", שמע מינה לתנא קמא דשרי היכא דאיכא חדא להתירא — כגון שוגג שלא במקומן, או מזיד במקומן — כיון דאיכא חדא לטיבותא; וקאמר רבי נחמיה: לעולם אסורים, עד דאיכא תרתי להתירא — שוגג ובמקומן. ולעולם תנאי היא:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:6:1.english: However, since it teaches - In that other [baraita]: "They are always forbidden..." — by inference they disagree on two [points], and the first tanna permits [them] even intentionally in their place. For if he is lenient regarding [only] one leniency, and Rabbi Neḥemya disagrees [only] with that one, this is what he should have taught, as is taught in the first [baraita]: "[If they are] in their place they may be eaten; not in their place, they may not be eaten." And I would know that regarding an unwitting [act], which the first tanna permitted [even] outside their place, Rabbi Neḥemya comes to say: That unwitting [act] which is permitted — [only] in their place is it permitted; outside their place, it is not. But since it teaches: "They are always forbidden until they return unwittingly," learn from it that according to the first tanna, it is permitted wherever there is one [factor] for permissibility — such as unwittingly outside their place, or intentionally in their place — since there is one [factor] in its favor; and Rabbi Neḥemya says: They are always forbidden until there are two [factors] for permissibility — unwittingly and in their place. And indeed, it is a [dispute between] tanna'im.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:7:1.english: A medium stride - A person's ordinary manner of walking [is] a cubit.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:1.english: [If] one established residence in a valley - He has two thousand cubits from his place in every direction.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:2.hebrew: והקיפוה נכרים מחיצות בשבת - ולדירה, כגון שהקיפוה לדור בתוכה; דאי לאו הכי, ביותר מבית סאתים לא משתריא לטלטולי בה אלא ד' אמות:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:2.english: And gentiles surrounded it [with] partitions on Shabbat - And [this applies when it was enclosed] for [the purpose of] dwelling, such as where they enclosed it to live inside it; for if not so, in [an area] larger than a beit se'atayim, it is not permitted to carry in it except [within] four cubits.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:3.hebrew: מהלך בה אלפים - דלא מהני ליה הנך מחיצות להיותה לו כד' אמות. דכי אמרינן "כל הבית כולו כד' אמות" — היכא דשבת באויר מחיצות מבעוד יום; אבל הכא, דבשעת שביתה לא הוו מחיצות — לא. ואפי' לרבן גמליאל, דאמר בהוציאוהו נכרים ונתנוהו בדיר או בסהר: דאע"ג דלא שבת באויר מחיצות, נעשית לו כארבע אמות ומהלך את כולה — התם הוא, דמי שהוציאוהו נכרים אין לו אלא ארבע אמות, הקילו חכמים אצלו להיות לו היקף מחיצות כארבע אמות; אבל הקונה שביתה, שיש לו אלפים אמה, לא הקילו חכמים אצלו להיות לו היקף מחיצות כארבע אמות, אלא אם כן שבת באוירן. ותדע, דהא רב הונא וחייא בר רב תלמידי דרב נינהו, ואמר רב: הלכה כרבן גמליאל בדיר וסהר, והכא אסרי כשמואל. ובמתני' נמי הכי תנן לקמן בפ' כיצד מעברין (עירובין דף סא.): ומודד שאמרו נותנין לו אלפים אמה, אפילו סוף מדתו כלה במערה — אינה לו כארבע אמות, ואילו הוציאוהו נכרים ונתנוהו בה — מהלך את כולה; והא — דברי הכל היא:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:3.english: He may walk in it two thousand [cubits] - For these partitions do not avail him to render [the enclosure] for him like four cubits. For when we say "the entire house is like four cubits," [that applies] where he established Shabbat residence within the airspace of partitions while it was still day; but here, where at the time of establishing residence there were no partitions, [that is] not [the case]. And even according to Rabban Gamliel, who said regarding [one whom] gentiles took out and placed in an animal pen or a corral that even though he did not establish residence within the airspace of partitions it becomes for him like four cubits and he may walk through all of it — that is [only] there, since one whom gentiles took out has only four cubits, the Sages were lenient with him to have the enclosure of partitions [considered] for him like four cubits; but one who establishes Shabbat residence who has two thousand cubits, the Sages were not lenient with him to have the enclosure of partitions [considered] for him like four cubits unless he established residence within their airspace. And know [that this is so], for Rav Huna and Ḥiyya bar Rav are disciples of Rav, and Rav said: "The halakhah is in accordance with Rabban Gamliel regarding an animal pen and a corral," yet here they prohibit [walking through the entire enclosure] in accordance with Shmuel. And in the Mishnah as well we learned this, later in the chapter [entitled] Keitzad Me'abberin (Eruvin 61a): "[Regarding] the surveyor that they spoke of, [to whom] they give two thousand cubits — even if the end of his measure terminates in a cave, it is not [considered] for him like four cubits; whereas if gentiles took him out and placed him in it, he may walk through all of it." And this is agreed upon by all!

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:4.hebrew: ומטלטל בכולה - אפי' חוץ לאלפים שאין לו רשות להלך, מותר לטלטל על ידי זריקה — כלומר, מותר לזרוק שם, דקיימא לן: מחיצה העשוייה בשבת שמה מחיצה. וממילא שמעינן דבתוך אלפיים מטלטל כדרכו, דהא מחיצות נינהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:8:4.english: And he may carry in all of it - Even beyond the two thousand [cubits], where he does not have permission to walk, it is permitted to carry by means of throwing — that is to say, it is permitted to throw [objects] there, as we hold: A partition made on Shabbat is considered a [valid] partition. And we automatically learn [from this] that within two thousand [cubits] he may carry in his usual manner, for behold, these are [valid] partitions.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:9:1.hebrew: ומטלטל בארבע אמות - כאילו לא היתה שם מחיצה, וטפי מארבע לא, ואפילו בזריקה; דלא שני לן בין טלטול כי אורחיה לטלטול דזריקה אלא במקום שמותר לטלטל ואסור להלך, כגון מתוך התחום לחוץ התחום. אבל במקום שהוא מותר להלך, אי שרי לטלטל בזריקה — שרי נמי לטלטל כי אורחיה, ואי אסיר — תרוייהו אסירי. וכיון דאסר ליה רב הונא לטלטל באלפים שלו, אפילו זריקה נמי אסור. וטעמא מפרש ואזיל:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:9:1.english: And he may carry within four cubits - As if there were no partition there, and [he may] not [carry] more than four [cubits], even by throwing. For we do not distinguish between carrying in the usual manner and carrying by throwing except in a place where it is permitted to carry but forbidden to walk, such as from within the [Sabbath] limit to outside the limit. But in a place where he is permitted to walk, if it is permitted to carry by throwing, it is also permitted to carry in the usual manner; and if it is forbidden, both are forbidden. And since Rav Huna forbade him to carry [more than four cubits] within his two thousand [cubits], even [carrying by] throwing is also forbidden. And [the Gemara] proceeds to explain the reason.

Rashi on Eruvin 42a:9:2.hebrew: ומקשינן לרב הונא ונטלטל בכולה - ואפילו חוץ לאלפים, ע"י זריקה? דהא קיימא לן: מחיצה הנעשית בשבת מחיצה היא, בפ"ב (דף כ.). ונהי דאיהו לא מצי אזיל — כיון דלא שבת באוירה לא הוי לה כארבע אמות — אבל מכל מקום מחיצות נינהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 42a:9:2.english: And we object to Rav Huna: "And let him carry throughout the entirety of it" - Even beyond the two thousand [cubits], by means of throwing? For behold, we maintain that a partition made on Shabbat is a [valid] partition, in chapter 2 (daf 20a). And granted that he cannot walk [there], since he did not spend Shabbat in its airspace [so that the enclosure] is not considered like four cubits for it; nevertheless, they are [valid] partitions!

Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:6:1.hebrew: מכלל דתנא קמא במזיד נמי שרי - נראה דהלכתא כתנא קמא. ואף על קב דקיימא לן משנת רבי אליעזר קב ונקי, הכא לא קיימא לן כוותיה אלא כרבנן, כיון דסבר רב פפא כרבנן. ואף בשוגג שלא במקומן נראה דהלכתא כת"ק דשרי, מדקאמרינן: במזיד במקומן כולי עלמא לא פליגי דאסור, כי פליגי בשוגג שלא במקומן; ואם כן, דרב פפא דשרי במזיד במקומן, כ"ש דשרי בשוגג שלא במקומן. ועוד, דקיימא לן דלא קנסינן שוגג אטו מזיד, לא בדאורייתא ולא בדרבנן. מיהו על כרחך הא דאסר ראב"י שוגג שלא במקומן — לאו משום דקניס שוגג אטו מזיד, דהא במקומן לא קניס שוגג אטו מזיד, אלא משום כיון דאין להן אלא ארבע אמות, גזרינן דילמא אתי להוציאן חוץ לארבע אמותיהן. וכן איתא בירושלמי, דקאמר: ר' נחמיה דאמר "עד שיחזרו למקומן שוגגין" אתיא כר"מ, דאמר: המבשל בשבת בשוגג יאכל. ואף ע"ג דהבא בשביל ישראל זה מותר לישראל אחר, ואמרינן לקמן (עירובין דף מז:) דחפצי נכרים קונין שביתה ולא גזרינן שמא יוציא חוץ לעיר — יש לחלק בין עיר לארבע אמות. ועוד, דכשנעשה ע"י נכרי לא החמירו. ועוד, הא דחפצי נכרי קונין שביתה — היינו דגזרו בעלים דנכרים אטו בעלים דישראל, ומשום הכי לא גזרינן שמא יוציא, דלא גזרינן גזירה לגזירה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:6:1.english: By inference, the first tanna holds that even if it was returned intentionally, it is also permitted - It appears that the halakhah is in accordance with the first tanna. And even though we maintain [the principle that] "the teaching of Rabbi Eliezer [ben Yaakov] is a kav and clean," here we do not maintain in accordance with him, but rather in accordance with the Rabbis, since Rav Pappa holds in accordance with the Rabbis. And even [in the case of produce taken out] unwittingly [that remains] not in its place, it appears that the halakhah is in accordance with the first tanna, who permits [it]—since we said: "[If returned] intentionally to their place, everyone agrees that it is forbidden; when they disagree, it is with regard to [produce taken out] unwittingly [that remains] not in its place." And if so, since Rav Pappa permits [it even when returned] intentionally to its place, all the more so does he permit [it when taken out] unwittingly [and remaining] not in its place! And furthermore, we maintain that we do not penalize an unwitting [act] on account of an intentional [act], neither in [matters of] Torah law nor in [matters of] Rabbinic law. However, perforce, that which Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov prohibits [in the case of produce taken out] unwittingly [that remains] not in its place is not because he penalizes an unwitting [act] on account of an intentional [act]—for in its [original] place he does not penalize an unwitting [act] on account of an intentional [act]! Rather, it is because since they have only four cubits, we decree lest one come to carry them beyond their four cubits. And so it is stated in the Yerushalmi: that Rabbi Neḥemya—who says "unless they are returned to their place unwittingly"—accords with Rabbi Meir, who says: One who cooks on Shabbat unwittingly may eat [the food]. And even though [regarding produce] that was brought for the sake of this Jew, it is permitted to another Jew; and we say later (Eruvin 47b) that objects belonging to gentiles acquire a place of Shabbat residence, and we do not decree lest he carry [them] outside the city—one can distinguish between a city and four cubits. And furthermore, when [an act] is done by a gentile, [the Sages] were not stringent. And furthermore, that [ruling] that objects belonging to a gentile acquire a place of Shabbat residence is [itself only] because they decreed [concerning] gentile owners on account of Jewish owners, and for that reason we do not decree lest he carry [them out], as we do not issue a decree upon a decree.

Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:8:1.hebrew: ונכרים שהקיפוה מחיצות - בירושלמי מוקי לה כרבי יהושע. ומיהו בקונט' פי' דאתיא נמי כר"ג, דאמר: נתנוהו בדיר או בסהר — מהלך את כולה, ואע"ג דלא שבת באויר מחיצות מבעוד יום — דלא הקילו חכמים אלא התם, דאין לו אלא ארבע אמות; אבל הכא, דיש לו אלפים, לא הקילו:
Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:8:1.english: "And gentiles who surrounded it with partitions" - In the Yerushalmi, [the Gemara] establishes it according to Rabbi Yehoshua. However, in the kuntres, [Rashi] explained that it also follows Rabban Gamliel, who said: [If] they placed him in a pen or in a fold, he may walk through all of it — even though he did not establish residence within the airspace of partitions while it was still day — for the Sages were lenient only there, where he has only four cubits; but here, where he has two thousand [cubits], they were not lenient.

Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:8:2.hebrew: ומטלטל בכולה ע"י זריקה - נראה לר"י, דאף תוך אלפים מטלטל ע"י זריקה, אבל כי אורחיה — אינו מטלטל אלא ארבע אמות; דלענין טלטול כי אורחיה, נפרצה למקום האסור לה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:8:2.english: "And he may carry in all of it by means of throwing" - It appears to the Ri that even within [his] two thousand [cubits], he may carry [only] by means of throwing, but in the usual manner he may carry only four cubits; for with respect to carrying in the usual manner, it is breached into a place that is forbidden to it.

Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:9:1.hebrew: וניטלטל בכולה ע"י זריקה - אע"ג דרב הונא אית ליה בסוף פ"ק (דף יז.) דשבת גורמת, והכא נאסר בתחילת שבת — לא דמי להכא; דרב הונא מודה במחיצה גמורה העשויה בשבת דשמה מחיצה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 42a:9:1.english: "And let him carry in the entire [area] by means of throwing" - Even though Rav Huna maintains at the end of the first chapter (17a) that [the onset of] Shabbat determines [the status], and here [the area] was forbidden at the onset of Shabbat, [that case] is not comparable to here; for Rav Huna concedes that a complete partition made on Shabbat is deemed a [valid] partition.
